scope.en: Isolated BodyParts3D skeletal exterior, reviewed in front/side/back and skull/pelvis close-ups. 206 bone-category meshes do not imply 206 anatomical bones. No motion-mechanics or mixed-source placement approval.
scope.zh: 独立 BodyParts3D 骨骼外形，已检查前/侧/后及颅骨/骨盆近景。206个骨类别网格不等于206块解剖骨。未接受运动力学或跨来源放置。

gateInterpretation: Historical scoped static review only; no new quality, anatomy, clinical, motion or runtime promotion.
limitations: 271 source representation meshes: 206 bone-category, 37 cartilage/disc and 28 dental context meshes; these are not an anatomical bone count or completeness claim.
28 source teeth, not complete 32-tooth dentition. Reduced-resolution atlas detail, not patient-specific or clinically validated.
Static exterior only. No mechanics, rigging, runtime or mixed-source patient registration approval.
Recorded derivative removed 4 exact zero-area source triangles; 2 near-zero-area triangles remained below 1e-14 m² in the recorded roundtrip. No new topology assessment.
